card.name: Digits inside dollar amounts
card.fires_on: A digit token inside a large dollar figure, usually right after $ and before a word like billion or million. It also fires on later digits of such figures and weakly on dose numbers.

modes.label: Money amounts
modes.description: Digits in dollar figures for sales, exports or costs, often followed by billion or million.
modes.example: In 2011 its global sales reached $<<3>>.2 billion.

modes.label: Later digits of a figure
modes.description: Digits after the first one in a multi-digit or decimal amount.
modes.example: In 2010, Mexico exported $15.<<4>>7 billion in minerals

modes.label: Dose numbers
modes.description: Leading digit of a dose amount, weaker than money amounts.
modes.example: up to <<1>>20 mcg/kg once daily not
